name: evidence.record
title: Record evidence
summary: Write a manual verification or validation record into an evidence folder of the workspace, for a check that is not an automated test; the element's UUID and current version are filled in.
details: The record is Markdown (evidence-record.schema.json). A verification names a requirement and optionally the acceptance criteria it proves (D-072), a validation a need or a requirement (D-012). Never replaces a file: a name that is taken gets -2, -3, ...
whileReadOnlyReason: Fills in the current version of the element, which depends on the metamodel (which properties count).

ref.description: The element the record is about. Its UUID and current version are written into the record; neither is an input (D-026).

kind.description: Verification of a requirement, or validation of a need or a requirement (D-007, D-012). A validation record counts for the validation status only (SR-030 AK3).

result.description: The result of the check. `inconclusive` is allowed for a validation only and needs a `reason` (SR-172 AK1).

reason.description: Why the validation is inconclusive (SR-172): required with the result `inconclusive`, not allowed with any other result. At least one character that is not white space, no control characters other than tab, line feed and carriage return.

item.description: The item under test, for example the build or sample. Required for verification. No white space at either end and no control characters other than tab, line feed and carriage return.

variant.description: A variant the element applies in (an element whose type has the meaning variant); the record holds for it. Absent: the core, and also every variant the element applies in when the element's repository is marked `variant-independent` in the workspace file (SR-173). Verification only: a variant with `kind` validation is `input.invalid` with `details.reason` `validation-with-variant` (SR-038 AK4, D-007). `core` names no variant and is `input.invalid` with `details.reason` `core-is-no-variant`; leave `variant` out for the core. A variant the element is not in is `input.invalid` with `details.reason` `not-valid-in-variant`, or `excluded-in-variant` or `replaced-in-variant` when the variant excludes or replaces the requirement (SR-047 AK4). Absent for a verification of an element the core does not hold, which would then count in no view, is `input.invalid` with `details.reason` `counts-in-no-view` (SR-047 AK5), unless the element's repository is marked `variant-independent` and a variant holds it (SR-173).

date.description: When the check was done. Default: the time of the call, UTC, whole seconds. Its first ten characters (the day in its own offset) start the file name.

evidence.description: Where the evidence document is: a path relative to the record file, a file URL or any URI. Written as given; ReqSeq never opens it (D-007).

testCase.description: Optional test case name or ID (`test-case` in the file, SR-033).

anyOf.description: A criterion key, or a number written as digits (the command line passes text).

criteria.description: The acceptance criteria the record holds for, each by its number (the position in the property with the meaning `acceptance-criteria` of the element's current version, counted from 1) or by its criterion key (D-072, SR-030 AK4). The file gets their criterion keys, sorted by key. Absent: the record holds for every criterion. `input.invalid`, and nothing is written, for a criterion without key (`details.reason` `criterion-without-key`, SR-030 AK4), a key that several criteria carry (`criterion-key-duplicate`, SR-030 AK5), and a number or key the current version does not have (`unknown-criterion`). Verification only: with `kind` validation it is `input.invalid` with `details.reason` `validation-with-criteria`, because a validation counts per element (SR-030 AK3).

folder.description: The folder to write into: an evidence location of the workspace file or a folder below one, relative to the workspace root (the folder of the main repository) with `/`, for example `evidence/manual` or `../tests/evidence`. Missing folders below the location are created. Default: the first evidence location whose repository is on this machine.

items.description: The written record file, relative to the workspace root as `workspacePath` gives it (with `/`).

criteria.description: With `criteria`: each criterion the record holds for, in the order of the criteria, with its number, its criterion key and the first 60 characters of its text (SR-030 AK4).

criterion.description: Its position in the current version, from 1.

text.description: The first 60 characters of its text.

record.description: The record as the Markdown reader reads it back from the written file (`source: markdown`, its repository and file, line 1), with the UUID and current version of the element.
